rav-idi-bar-gershom.name: Rav Idi bar Gershom
rav-idi-bar-gershom.bio: Amora who transmits a ruling of Rav Adda bar Ahava in Keritot 9a.
rav-idi-bar-gershom.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying dark beard and a sand-coloured wool mantle, reciting a ruling he received from his teacher with one hand open; background of a mud-brick study hall lit by an oil lamp.

rabbi-chanina-tirnaa.name: Rabbi Ḥanina of Tirna’a
rabbi-chanina-tirnaa.bio: Amora who asks Rabbi Yoḥanan a question in Keritot 9a.
rabbi-chanina-tirnaa.prompt: An inquisitive sage of the Land of Israel in his 40s with a dark brown beard and a slate-blue linen mantle, leaning forward as he puts a question to his teacher; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
